# Identification where runs part / 运行分开之处的辨识

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`identification-where-runs-part` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](identification-where-runs-part.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Wherever the runs of a process register one course, a record fixes it from 2N − 1 on with N configurations, as for determined laws. At a parting no learner, whatever it is given, is right on both runs; for listed, decided processes a learner given the world is right exactly where none part.
>
> 凡一个过程的运行所识的是同一历程之处，配置数为 N 时，记录从 2N − 1 起确定它，与确定的律一样。在分开之处，没有学习者，无论被给予什么（世界在内），在两个运行上都对；列出、可判定的过程中，被给予世界的学习者恰在不分开之处都对。

## Laws / 规律

1. Two runs part at a step where they register the same before it and differ at it; their records before it are one, so no learner, whatever it is given, is right on both; a learner right from T on, on every run from a configuration, leaves no two of those runs parting from T on.<br>两个运行在某步之前所识相同、在该步不同，即在该步分开；两者在该步之前的记录是同一个，所以没有学习者，无论被给予什么，在两者上都对；在从一个配置出发的每个运行上从 T 起都对的学习者，使这些运行在 T 之后不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.PartAt`, `Becoming.Parting.RightAt`, `Becoming.Parting.course`, `Becoming.Parting.not_right_on_both`, `Becoming.Parting.not_parting_of_right`)
2. With the registered values decided, no two runs from a configuration part exactly where all of them register one course.<br>所识的值可判定时，从一个配置出发没有两个运行分开，恰当它们所识的是同一历程。 (`Becoming.Parting.Unparted`, `Becoming.Parting.unparted_iff`)
3. Not parting is kept along runs: a run up to a step joined to any run from where it is at that step is a run from its start, so every configuration a run from an unparted configuration reaches is unparted.<br>不分开沿运行保持：把一个运行到某步为止，与从它在那一步所在处出发的任一运行相连，得到从其起点出发的运行，所以从不分开的配置出发的运行所到之处也不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.after`, `Becoming.Parting.before`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt_before`, `Becoming.Parting.joinAt_after`, `Becoming.Parting.Unparted.along`)
4. On a run from an unparted configuration held by a list of N configurations the registered course has at most N states, and the learner by the least bound, given nothing, is right from N + N − 1 on; for N ≥ 2 no learner is right at N + N − 2 on every such run of every process of N configurations.<br>从不分开的配置出发、被 N 个配置的列表所持的运行，其所识的历程至多有 N 个状态，以最小的界读记录的学习者不被给予什么，从 N + N − 1 起每步都对；N ≥ 2 时没有学习者在每个这样的运行上于 N + N − 2 都对。 (`Becoming.Parting.course_statesBelow`, `Becoming.Parting.leastBound_right`, `Becoming.Parting.rest_earliest_runs`)
5. A determined process with one move parts nowhere, so determined laws are the instance; a branching that does not show in what is registered parts nowhere either.<br>一个动作的确定过程处处不分开，所以确定的律是实例；分支不显于所识者也不分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.states_agree`, `Becoming.Parting.unparted_of_determined`, `Becoming.Parting.free_unparted_const`)
6. Under free branching every course is a run's course; after every record two runs with that record part, every learner is not right at the next step on one of them, and one run makes it wrong at every step.<br>自由分支下每个历程都是一个运行的历程；每个记录之后，两个有这一记录的运行分开，每个学习者在其中一个上于下一步不对，且有一个运行使它每步都不对。 (`Becoming.Parting.free`, `Becoming.Parting.freeRun`, `Becoming.Parting.freeRun_course`, `Becoming.Parting.free_parts_after`, `Becoming.Parting.free_open`, `Becoming.Parting.free_never_right`)
7. Free branching on two values is held by a list of two configurations, and one of its runs has a registered course with no bound on its states.<br>两个值上的自由分支被两个配置的列表所持，其中一个运行所识的历程没有状态数的界。 (`Becoming.Parting.free_held`, `Becoming.Parting.free_unbounded`)
8. Where runs part only before step T and never after, the registered values decided, no two runs part from where a run is at T; held by N configurations its course has at most T + N states, and the learner by the least bound is right from 2(T + N) − 1 on.<br>运行只在 T 步之前分开、此后不分开时，所识的值可判定，从一个运行在 T 所在处出发没有两个运行分开；被 N 个配置所持时其历程至多 T + N 个状态，以最小的界读记录的学习者从 2(T + N) − 1 起每步都对。 (`Becoming.Parting.unparted_at_of_late`, `Becoming.Parting.statesBelow_shift`, `Becoming.Parting.late_statesBelow`, `Becoming.Parting.late_right`)
9. Where a list of N holds every configuration, from where a course of N steps starts a step leads to where one starts: the course repeats a configuration and can go round; so courses of every length start there, with no decidability and no selection. With decided steps and listed moves, a run goes on from there, built by taking at each step the first successor from which one can.<br>N 个配置的列表持有每个配置时，由之有 N 步历程的配置，一步之后仍然如此：长 N 的历程重复一个配置，绕着重复可以走任意长；所以由之有任意长的历程，不用判定也不用选取。步可判定、动作列出时，由之有无尽的运行，每步取第一个仍可走下去的后继造出。 (`Becoming.Parting.path_of_continues`, `Becoming.Parting.continues_cycle`, `Becoming.Parting.continues_persists`, `Becoming.Parting.continues_any`, `Becoming.Parting.unbounded_of_continues`, `Becoming.Parting.anyOf`, `Becoming.Parting.anyOf_true`, `Becoming.Parting.anyOf_of_mem`, `Becoming.Parting.and_both`, `Becoming.Parting.and_of`, `Becoming.Parting.choose`, `Becoming.Parting.live`, `Becoming.Parting.live_succ_iff`, `Becoming.Parting.live_of_run`, `Becoming.Parting.live_iff_continues`, `Becoming.Parting.live_persists`, `Becoming.Parting.advance`, `Becoming.Parting.advanced`, `Becoming.Parting.liveRun`, `Becoming.Lasting.Continues`, `Becoming.Lasting.Unbounded`)
10. The converse: with decided steps and registered values, the learner given the world reads from the record the configurations a run can be at, takes the first from which a run goes on, and claims what it registers; it is right at a step on every run from a configuration exactly where no two of those runs part there, so some learner is right there exactly where none part.<br>反方向：步与所识的值可判定时，被给予世界的学习者从记录读出运行可能所在的配置，取第一个由之可走下去者，说它所识的值；它在某步于从一个配置出发的每个运行上都对，恰当没有两个这样的运行在该步分开；所以某个学习者在那里对，恰当没有运行在那里分开。 (`Becoming.Parting.keepIf`, `Becoming.Parting.mem_keepIf`, `Becoming.Parting.candidates`, `Becoming.Parting.firstLive`, `Becoming.Parting.firstLive_spec`, `Becoming.Parting.firstLive_found`, `Becoming.Parting.worldLearner`, `Becoming.Parting.run_in_candidates`, `Becoming.Parting.candidates_run`, `Becoming.Parting.world_right`, `Becoming.Parting.world_right_iff`, `Becoming.Parting.some_right_iff`)

## Conditions / 条件

- No axiom. What each law needs is written into it: a run held by a list, a start unparted or unparted from T on; unparted_iff, leastBound_right, the late_ laws and free_open need the registered values decided; world_right and its kin need listed moves and configurations and decided steps; free_never_right, free_held and free_unbounded are stated on two values (Bool).<br>不加公理。各律所写者写在定理中：运行被列表所持，起点的配置不分开或从 T 起不分开；unparted_iff、leastBound_right、late_* 与 free_open 要所识的值可判定；world_right 等要动作与配置列出、步可判定；free_never_right、free_held 与 free_unbounded 陈述在两个值上。
- The learner reads the values registered at configurations; moves register only where the registration reads them (for instance, where a configuration carries its last move).<br>学习者读配置所识的值；动作只在识读它们时被识（例如配置带着它的上一个动作）。

## Does not show / 未表明

- A bound on configurations bounds no course where runs part.<br>配置数的界在运行分开之处不约束历程。 Witness: `Becoming.Parting.free_unbounded`.
- The learner given the world for infinite or undecided processes: the construction needs listed moves and configurations and decided steps, and elsewhere whether a run goes on is not decided in general.<br>无限或步不可判定的过程中被给予世界的学习者：构造要配置与动作列出、步可判定，那里由之能否走下去一般不可判定。
- Whether 2(T + N) − 1 is exact for every T is not shown.<br>2(T + N) − 1 对每个 T 是否恰好，没有表明。
- **Counterexample / 反例:** free_parts_after: after every record two runs of free branching with that record part; free_never_right: for every learner, the diagonal run of free branching makes it wrong at every step; free_unbounded: a run on two configurations whose course is no lasso and has no bound on its states.<br>free_parts_after：每个记录之后，自由分支上两个有这一记录的运行分开；free_never_right：对每个学习者，自由分支上的对角运行使它每步都不对；free_unbounded：两个配置上的一个运行，其历程不是任何套索，没有状态数的界。 [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Parting.lean)

### Correspondence / 对应

Ren, 15 October 2026: “"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”, with the core read as the whole covering all reality where things and changes exist, with zero axioms, and “if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”. The identification line (identification-where-bounded) is stated for determined laws; this states it for every process, determined laws being one case. Known result: no learner right on both at a parting is the indistinguishability argument, a diagonal argument in the style of Gold (1967, “Language identification in the limit”); parting and distinguishing tests go back to Moore (1956, “Gedanken-experiments on sequential machines”). The AI's note: “the full "truth" can be derived, situationally” (12 October) holds for what is registered, as far as runs do not part; that every situation is bounded is not derived with no axiom. The AI's first reading, “at a parting the branch is settled only when taken”, is withdrawn; Ren, 16 October 2026: “the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”. Read so (the AI's reading of Ren's words, which Ren took the same day): at a parting, what the record and the supplied law leave open the situation fixes (weights-count-situations).<br>Ren 2026-10-15：“"What this line doesn’t reach" is also worth doing”，并说核心是覆盖有物与变化的全部实在、零公理者，且“if my earlier words are unreasonable, please keep note, not follow blindly”。辨识一线对确定的律陈述，这里对每个过程。已知：分开处无学习者两者都对是不可区分论证，是 Gold（1967，“Language identification in the limit”）式的对角论证；分开与区分的检验可追溯到 Moore（1956，“Gedanken-experiments on sequential machines”）。AI 的注：2026-10-12 的“the full "truth" can be derived, situationally”对所识者成立，到运行不分开为止；每个情境都有界不由零公理推出。原先的 AI 读法“分开处的分支只在被走时定下”已撤回；Ren 2026-10-16：“the actual change depends on the situation … the situation makes it true”。读法（Ren 同日已取）：分开处记录与所给的律不固定的，由情境固定（weights-count-situations）。
